paragraphs.text: More than just a face and a voice. A PAL is a whole person: an AI that pays attention, responds in real time, and works alongside you like a real partner.

paragraphs.text: Expresses emotion and moves naturally, reacting in real time just like a person would.

paragraphs.text: Takes on the role, personality, and rules you give it. Remembers every conversation and picks up right where you left off.

paragraphs.fontFamily: "Fk Raster Grotesk Compact Blended", Arial, sans-serif

paragraphs.text: Speaks naturally in real time, with the rhythm, warmth, and inflection of a real human.

paragraphs.text: Presents decks, creates visuals on the fly, shares its screen, and joins your Zoom or Google Meet calls, all out of the box.

paragraphs.fontFamily: "Fk Raster Grotesk Compact Blended", Arial, sans-serif

paragraphs.text: Reads your expressions, your focus, and the world around you to understand the full context.

paragraphs.fontFamily: "Fk Raster Grotesk Compact Blended", Arial, sans-serif
